purpose: Exploratory local test of role-answer accuracy and prompt/voice sensitivity in pretrained language models while the synthetic confirmation runs.

design.generation: greedy, maximum 8 new tokens, local model weights

scoring: An answer is correct only if, after trimming whitespace and terminal punctuation, it is exactly the intended name. Other text and the other name count as errors. Preserve raw outputs.
outcomes: accuracy by model, voice, role and wording
limits: This small synthetic-language pilot is exploratory. Pretraining exposure is unknown, so it cannot establish that a name pair or construction was unseen. Answers alone cannot establish the model's internal mechanism.
